featured_reviews.name: Kartikeya Pathak
featured_reviews.review_text:
PVR Cinema – Oberoi Mall, Mumbai

I recently visited PVR Cinema at Oberoi Mall, Mumbai, and had a fantastic overall experience. Of course, the cinema itself lives up to the PVR standard – clean, comfortable seating, great sound and picture quality, and a well-maintained ambiance. But what really caught me by surprise this time was the food.

We decided to try the hotdogs, and honestly, they were far better than the typical movie-snack expectations. The buns were perfectly steamed – soft, warm, and fresh – which made a big difference in texture. The sausage was juicy and flavorful, and they nailed the condiment-to-meat ratio. Nothing was overly messy or underwhelming – just a really well-balanced, satisfying bite that felt thoughtfully put together rather than rushed.

Another nice touch was the small Costa Coffee counter inside the cinema area. It’s not a full café, but they do serve the essentials. We ordered an iced latte, and it was surprisingly good – strong but not bitter, with just the right amount of milk and ice. It was a refreshing complement to the hot food and added to the overall premium feel of the experience.

All in all, PVR Oberoi Mall offers more than just movies – it’s clearly putting effort into creating a quality experience across the board, including the food and beverage options. Whether you’re here for a blockbuster or just want a relaxed evening out, this location delivers on multiple fronts. Definitely looking forward to going back.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Movie Time is just a 10-minute walk from the Dahisar Metro Station, but finding it was a bit of a struggle since there were no signs outside to guide us. Unlike most theatres, there’s no clear entry point, which made things confusing.

The lift situation wasn’t great either—there’s only one, and it barely fits five people, so getting in and out felt like a waiting game. Inside, there’s just one screen, and honestly, the theatre felt more like a small pod. The viewing experience was okay, but the sound quality could have been way better.

Now, let’s talk about the seats—definitely not the most comfortable. Sitting through a long movie was a bit of a task. On the plus side, the food area was clean, but the prices? Almost as high as PVR, which felt a bit much for the overall experience.

One good thing—they have free underground parking for both bikes and cars, which is a rare win in Mumbai!

Overall, if you’re nearby and just want to catch a movie, it works. But if you’re looking for a top-tier cinema experience, this might not be the best pick.

Visited MovieTime Cinemas at Hub Mall with a group of friends on a Friday, expecting a good movie experience, but it turned out to be quite disappointing.

The experience started on a positive note. The security staff were welcoming, the common area was clean, and there were plenty of food options available. However, the popcorn wasn’t worth the price.

The washrooms were also decently maintained. The real disappointment began when we entered the auditorium. There was a strong foul smell throughout the hall, making it very uncomfortable to sit. What surprised us even more was that the auditorium wasn’t cleaned after the previous show empty popcorn tubs, Coke cups, and other litter were still lying around. There were even mosquitoes and flies inside the hall, which completely ruined the overall experience.

The only reason I’m not giving a one-star rating is because the screen quality and sound system were actually quite good.

For a theatre in a mall, basic hygiene and maintenance should never be compromised. I sincerely hope the management focuses on cleaning the auditoriums and renovating the seating, as the current condition is far below expectations.

Staff: 4/5

INOX at Thakur Mall in Dahisar is a popular entertainment hub for residents in the Dahisar and Mira Road areas. Located on the 3rd floor of the mall, it is known for being a well-maintained multiplex that offers a premium cinematic experience at relatively competitive prices compared to other major malls in Mumbai.
Screens: The multiplex typically operates 4 screens, featuring both 2D and 3D projection technology.

​Accessibility: The cinema is equipped with wheelchair facilities and elevator access.
Refreshments: There is a dedicated F&B counter inside INOX serving classic movie snacks like popcorn, nachos, and sandwiches.

At this point, missing a scene here is nearly impossible—not because of great service, but because punctuality clearly isn’t part of the experience.

Would not recommend if you value your time.

featured_reviews.name: Faraz Ansari
featured_reviews.review_text:
Location & Accessibility
PVR Citi Mall is conveniently situated inside Citi Mall on Andheri Link Road, near Bhaktivedanta Swami Mission School in Oshiwara, Andheri West. It's approximately 0.7 km from D.N. Nagar metro station and about 3 km from Andheri railway station—making it easily accessible by both metro and train .

Ambience & Facilities
This multiplex stands out for its modern, well-maintained interiors and ambient decor. Regular amenities include recliner seating, digital ticketing, wheelchair access, air conditioning, food & beverage counters, and parking . According to aggregated data, it holds a solid average rating of 4.2 out of 5, reflecting consistently positive visitor experiences .

Viewing Experience
The picture and sound quality are frequently praised. A reviewer exclaimed: “Amazing sound quality, large screens and yes the food options are so good that you can actually have dinner while watching a movie there!” . Others highlight comfortable seating with decent legroom, crisp visuals, and reliable acoustics—a true immersive cinematic experience .

Value & Pricing
While not the cheapest option, the multiplex strikes a commendable balance between quality and cost. “Affordable rates of movie tickets” assures one user, and another noted it’s cheaper compared to nearby PVR outlets . However, concession stand prices are notably high, which is common in most multiplexes .

Room for Improvement
There are occasional complaints about minor inconveniences: some reports mention cramped seating in certain areas, delayed show starts by 10–15 minutes, and pricing concerns for snacks . Cleanliness and general upkeep are good but have room to be elevated to match the premium ambience.

---

Summary Table

Feature	Rating & Highlights

Overall Rating	4.2 / 5
Location	Very accessible via metro and train
Ambience & Comfort	Modern interiors, comfortable seating, AC
Viewing Quality	Excellent sound & visuals, immersive experience
Value	Reasonably priced tickets; snacks on the higher side
Concerns	Occasional delays, snack pricing, sparse lapses in seating space

---

Final Verdict:
PVR Citi Mall in Andheri West offers a high-quality cinema experience with modern amenities, accessible location, and immersive audiovisuals. Minor points regarding concessions pricing and occasional delays don’t significantly detract from its overall appeal. For movie lovers seeking comfort and convenience without breaking the bank, this is a reliable choice—earning a well-deserved 4.2 out of 5 stars.

featured_reviews.name: Srijith Pillai
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited PVR Citi Mall, Andheri (W), Mumbai to watch the Malayalam movie “Drishyam 3”, and it was a really nice cinema experience.

Citi Mall is one of the older buildings in Andheri West, but what I liked is that it still maintains its class and charm. Even though the building has been there for many years, the cinema experience inside still feels comfortable, organised, and enjoyable. It has that old Mumbai theatre feeling, but with modern facilities added properly.

The location is also a big advantage. Being in the centre of Andheri West, on Link Road, it is easy to access and convenient for movie lovers from nearby areas. For someone coming to watch a movie after work, with family, or with friends, the location works very well.

The seating was comfortable, and the premium chairs made the movie experience even better. The recliner-style seating and overall comfort helped us enjoy the movie without any discomfort. The screen, sound, air conditioning, and theatre atmosphere were all good, and it felt like PVR has maintained the place well.

The food and beverage options also added to the experience. Having snacks and food available inside the cinema makes it easy to enjoy the movie fully. The food counters, movie snacks, and overall service were convenient and well managed. The adjustable food trays in the seating area are also very useful, especially when you want to enjoy your snacks comfortably during the movie.

What I appreciated most is that PVR Citi Mall has kept its standard despite being in an older mall. The place still offers good facilities like comfortable seating, premium chairs, food and beverages, parking, mobile ticketing, wheelchair-friendly access, air conditioning, and a proper multiplex experience.

Watching a Malayalam movie like Drishyam 3 there felt special. The crowd, the theatre feel, the comfort, and the overall setup made it a memorable movie outing.

Overall, PVR Citi Mall, Andheri (W) is a good cinema option in Mumbai for anyone looking for a comfortable movie experience in a very convenient location. It carries the charm of an old building but still gives the facilities and comfort expected from a modern PVR cinema. Definitely a nice place to watch movies with family, friends, or even alone.

featured_reviews.name: Sachin Kumar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently watched a movie at PVR Citimall Theatre, and while the experience had its positives, there were also a few drawbacks. The seating was decent but not very comfortable; the seats felt a bit stiff, which made it tough to stay relaxed throughout the film. For a theatre experience, I expected a higher level of comfort.

One major downside was the lengthy advertisements. Although the movie was scheduled for 10:30 pm, it didn’t actually start until 10:54 pm because of nearly half an hour of ads. It’s understandable to have a few commercials, but this was excessive and made the wait for the actual movie feel frustrating. When people choose a specific showtime, it’s disappointing to sit through so many ads before the main feature even begins.

On a positive note, the theatre does offer a few conveniences. The food options were available and well-maintained, and washrooms were easily accessible and clean. They also provided drinking water facilities, which was a nice touch. However, despite these conveniences, the excessive ads and less-than-comfortable seats would make me think twice before choosing this theatre again for a movie night. A few adjustments could really improve the experience for patrons.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Overview
Cinépolis is one of the most popular multiplex chains in Mumbai, known for its sleek, modern design and high-end cinematic technology. Whether you are visiting the one in Andheri, Thane, or Navi Mumbai, the vibe is consistently premium. It’s a top-tier choice for movie-goers who prioritize comfort, crystal-clear visuals, and a great atmosphere for a day out with friends or family.
Pros:
Superior Comfort: The seating is well-spaced with excellent legroom. If you opt for the VIP or IMAX screens, the leather recliners are incredibly cozy.
Cutting-Edge Tech: They use advanced laser projection and Dolby Atmos sound systems, making the action feel very immersive.
Variety of Formats: Depending on the location, you can choose from 4DX (moving seats/effects), IMAX, or their luxury "Coffee Tree" service.
Cleanliness: The lobbies and washrooms are generally well-maintained and have a "high-class" feel.
Cons:
Expensive Concessions: Like most premium malls, the popcorn and sodas are quite pricey—sometimes costing more than the movie ticket itself!
Peak Hour Crowds: During big blockbuster releases or weekends, the lobby can get very crowded, leading to long queues at the security check and food counters.
Parking Fees: Since most Cinépolis theaters are inside major malls, you’ll have to pay the standard (and sometimes steep) mall parking rates.

featured_reviews.name: Khubaib Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text: Cinepolis Andheri has always been more than just a movie theatre for me. I have been visiting this place for more than a decade, and every single visit carries a different memory attached to it. From watching exciting first day first shows with friends to spending peaceful evenings alone with popcorn and a good film, this place has silently witnessed many phases of my life. The atmosphere, the familiar ticket counters, the glowing posters, and even the smell of freshly made popcorn instantly bring back old emotions whenever I walk inside. No matter how much the city changes, Cinepolis Andheri still feels comfortingly familiar to me. Some places are special because of their beauty, while others become special because of the memories created there. For me, this theatre represents laughter, friendships, excitement, and countless unforgettable moments. Every corner reminds me of a different chapter of my journey. Even today, whenever I visit Cinepolis Andheri, I feel the same happiness and nostalgia that I felt years ago, making it a truly irreplaceable place in my heart. No matter how busy life becomes, returning there always feels like revisiting a comforting piece of my past that still warmly welcomes me home again

If you want to watch a movie without burning a hole in your pocket, Movie Time at Hub Mall is a solid choice. The screens are decent, the seating is comfortable enough for a two-hour show, and they screen a good mix of regional and mainstream cinema. Post-movie, there are plenty of reliable food spots right inside the premises like McDonald's and local eateries.
​It’s not a massive premium lifestyle mall to hang out in all day, but for a planned movie-and-dinner outing with family or friends that doesn't cost a fortune, it does the job perfectly. Just wish the parking management and public restrooms were kept cleaner.
